purpose: Define the only translation-specific semantic result shape accepted from the existing scheduled ChatGPT data-plane.

field_rules.results: array of zero or more unique result records; zero results do not imply completeness

field_rules.request_id: must exactly match one current GitHub-prepared request
field_rules.source_key: must exactly echo current request source_key
field_rules.source_appid: must exactly echo current request source_appid
field_rules.source_text_sha256: must exactly echo current request source_text_sha256
field_rules.source_version: must exactly echo current request source_version
field_rules.translated_text_ru: required and nonempty only when status=translated; acceptance additionally requires classify_description(...)=good_ru
field_rules.error_code: required nonempty machine-readable string only when status=error
field_rules.quality_note: optional concise worker note; never authoritative for acceptance

cross_field_rules: status=translated requires translated_text_ru and forbids error_code
status=error requires error_code and forbids translated_text_ru
all identity/hash echoes must match the exact current request before any text is considered
duplicate request_id within one submission is invalid
